teachBack.text: Let me say it back. You check the work history first. Three or more years of production machine learning goes to the fast track, and needs an interviewer before you advance. UZH applications are held until Reto decides. Referrals from employees go to the founders, and applicants from an investor or customer go to the CEO. Candidates asking for a high salary also go to the founders. Is that right?

corrections.text: Almost. The founders step isn't about salary, it's only for referrals. The rest is right.
